from_speaker: if the government appears arbitrary and capricious
(effectively) abruptly shutting down an entire thriving industry
our_interpretation: In context, the effective shutdown concerns Fable, Mythos, and activity dependent on them. It is not a literal assertion that every US AI company stopped operating.
The sentence combines an operational event with a universal causal maxim and judgments about governmental conduct.

No ordinary, sufficiently stable measure of thrive or appearing arbitrary is supplied. Selecting revenue, investment, service availability, or another measure would materially rewrite the causal claim.
The June 12 suspension can be checked as context, but cannot settle the whole sentence.
criteria.support_condition: No fair binary support condition exists for the whole claim without adding a measure of thriving, an exposure period, and a standard for apparent arbitrariness.
criteria.contradiction_condition: No fair binary contradiction condition exists for the whole claim. Continued operation of unrelated AI services would not refute the contextual effective-shutdown language.
